title: Spa Bali Moon: re-roll (bolder)
question: Hand yang lebih berani. Semua kartu memakai 6 warna brand (Warm Ivory, Soft Sand, Warm Taupe, Muted Sage, Deep Olive, Warm Brown). Yang berbeda hanya bentuk, komposisi dan interaksinya.

options.label: The Treatment Specimen
options.thesis: Each treatment set like a type specimen: drag the duration and the name and price re-set live.
materials: tiny Manrope labels and live readouts
options.viewport: One treatment name ('Balinese Massage') fills the width in huge serif; beneath it a duration slider (1 · 1.5 · 2 hours) moves a live 'IDR 159K' readout; photo inset; WhatsApp button books exactly what is selected.
options.risk: A type specimen is a designer's artifact; it may feel cold unless the photography carries warmth.

raised.raise: One original photograph per page is scaled boldly across the layout instead of many small thumbnails.
Every page opens on one long sightline: a single centered axis the eye travels down to the booking action.

options.label: The Treatment Board
options.lineage: airport and rail split-flap departure boards
options.thesis: The spa menu as a departure board every traveler already knows how to read: treatment, duration, price, book.
materials: deep-olive flap cells with ivory letters
options.viewport: Photo hero with the H1; below the fold a single deep-olive board lists treatments in fixed columns; switching Massage/Beauty/For Couples cascades the flaps; each row ends in a WhatsApp 'Book' cell.
options.case: Wins both axes: tourists read boards instinctively and it is the clearest price table possible.
options.risk: Transit/industrial if overused; the dark board must stay one contained object, not dark sections.

options.label: Silk Selendang Ribbon
options.lineage: late-modern corporate prospectus, one rendered ribbon of color
options.thesis: Almost everything is empty ivory; all the color is spent on one continuous silk sash of sage, taupe and sand.
materials: one rendered silk ribbon (like a temple selendang)
options.viewport: Headline left over 48% of the width; the silk ribbon unfurls across the right bleed behind a single treatment photo; one olive booking button.
options.case: Competitive: very calm and clear, but its corporate origin fights 'not a corporate wellness brand'.
options.risk: Slides toward corporate polish if the photography is too small.

options.label: The Drawcord Sarong
options.lineage: silk cape gathered by hidden drawcords
options.thesis: Content arrives as flat cloth; pulling a cord gathers it into pleats that reveal the treatment's details and prices.
materials: a single taupe drawcord as the control
options.viewport: A wide sand-colored cloth plane with the H1; a taupe cord runs across it; pulling it gathers the plane into pleats that open the treatment menu.
options.case: Competitive: textile warmth fits a spa, but gathering interactions slow price-finding.
options.risk: Interaction novelty over clarity on phones.

options.label: Panel-Wrap Photo
options.lineage: printed vinyl car wraps with sponsor strips
options.thesis: One photo scaled across panels with visible seams.
options.viewport: A single huge treatment photo broken across three panels, treatment chips along the sill.
options.case: Declined: loud pop-culture energy undercuts calm; weaker clarity.
options.kept: Scale one original photo boldly instead of many small ones.

options.label: Garden Axis
options.thesis: The site as a formal garden walk of mirrored parterres.
options.viewport: A symmetrical garden plan with treatments as parterres.
options.case: Declined: reads as five-star palace luxury, which the brief rejects.
options.kept: One long central sightline leading to the booking action.

canonCard.label: Luxury spa editorial (category standard)
canonCard.thesis: What every Bali spa site ships, executed with full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Full-bleed photo hero, centered serif headline, two buttons, then a grid of treatment cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
